title: MANAGER – CREDIT SOLUTIONS
description:
**Hiring Partner:**
Magsum Solutions

**Hiring For:**
Vanmoh

**Location:**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Reporting To:**
Head of Credit / Senior Management

**About the Role**

Vanmoh is expanding its financial services portfolio with a focus on providing customers with accessible and structured
**credit and lending solutions**
.

We are looking for an experienced
**Manager – Credit Solutions**
to manage and grow the credit solutions function, covering customer acquisition, loan processing, credit assessment coordination, documentation, disbursement and portfolio follow-up.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of lending processes, credit operations and customer relationship management, with the ability to balance
**business growth with credit quality and risk discipline**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Credit Business Development**

* Drive growth of Vanmoh’s credit solutions business.
* Identify and develop new customer acquisition channels.
* Build relationships with customers, channel partners, DSAs, agents and other business partners.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly business targets.
* Develop strategies to increase loan enquiries, applications and disbursements.

**2. Loan & Credit Processing**

* Manage the complete credit processing cycle from application to disbursement.
* Verify customer applications and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate collection and verification of KYC, income and other required documents.
* Ensure applications are processed accurately and within defined turnaround times.
* Coordinate with credit, operations, legal and documentation teams.

**3. Credit Assessment Coordination**

* Conduct preliminary assessment of customer applications.
* Review customer financial information, repayment capacity and credit history.
* Identify potential credit risks and escalate cases requiring detailed assessment.
* Coordinate with the credit/risk team for final underwriting and approval.
* Ensure lending decisions are supported by complete and accurate documentation.

**4. Customer & Partner Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
* Understand customer financial requirements and recommend appropriate credit solutions.
* Manage channel partners and referral sources.
* Ensure transparent communication regarding eligibility, documentation, pricing, repayment and other terms.
* Handle customer queries and coordinate resolution of service issues.

**5. Disbursement & Operations**

* Coordinate approved cases through documentation and disbursement.
* Ensure all pre-disbursement requirements are completed.
* Track applications at every stage and minimise processing delays.
* Maintain accurate records of applications, approvals, rejections and disbursements.

**6. Portfolio Monitoring & Collections Coordination**

* Monitor the performance of the credit portfolio.
* Track repayment status and overdue accounts.
* Coordinate with the collections team on delinquent accounts.
* Identify early warning indicators and escalate potential portfolio risks.
* Support initiatives to improve repayment performance and reduce delinquency.

**7. MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly credit business reports.
* Track:
* Applications received
* Applications processed
* Approvals
* Rejections
* Disbursements
* Disbursement value
* Turnaround time
* Overdue accounts
* Portfolio performance
* Provide management with regular updates and insights.

**8. Process & Compliance**

* Ensure all credit activities follow Vanmoh’s internal policies and approval processes.
* Maintain proper KYC and documentation standards.
* Ensure customer data and financial information are handled confidentially.
* Follow applicable regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Identify gaps in the credit process and recommend improvements.

**9. Team Management**

* Manage and mentor credit/operations executives where applicable.
* Allocate applications and responsibilities across the team.
* Set team-level targets and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide training.
* Build a disciplined, customer-focused credit operations team.

**Key KRAs / KPIs**

Monthly loan/credit disbursement value

Number of new customers acquired

Application-to-disbursement conversion

Processing turnaround time

Portfolio quality

Delinquency / overdue levels

Customer retention

Channel partner productivity

Documentation accuracy

Compliance adherence

Team productivity

**Required Qualifications**

Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration or a related field.

MBA / PGDM in Finance will be an advantage.

4–8 years of relevant experience in credit, lending or financial services.

**Preferred Industry Experience**

Candidates with experience in:

NBFCs

Banks

Chit funds

Consumer finance

Business loans

Personal loans

Secured / unsecured lending

Fintech

Credit distribution

Loan processing

will be preferred.

Experience handling
**branch-based lending or credit operations**
will be an added advantage.

**Skills Required**

Credit & lending process knowledge

Financial analysis

Customer relationship management

Loan documentation

Risk awareness

Business development

Negotiation skills

Team management

MIS & reporting

MS Excel

CRM / loan management systems

Strong communication skills

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for someone who can balance
**business growth and credit discipline**
.

The ideal candidate should be:

Commercially driven but risk conscious.

Strong in customer and partner relationships.

Comfortable working with targets.

Good at analysing customer financial information.

Highly organised with documentation.

Capable of independently managing credit operations.

Proactive in identifying risks and operational issues.

Comfortable working with senior management and cross-functional teams.

**Compensation**

**Compensation:**
Competitive and based on experience and proven capability.

**Performance incentives:**
Applicable based on agreed business and portfolio targets.

**Location:**
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Joining:**
Immediate

title: Associate cluster manager for banca
description:
**Company Description**
Health Insurance Care is dedicated to helping individuals and families access Affordable Care Act information and obtain quality health insurance coverage. The organization focuses on making healthcare plans understandable, accessible, and cost-effective for a wide range of customers. By offering guidance on available options and eligibility, Health Insurance Care supports informed decision-making about medical and financial protection. Team members contribute to improving community health outcomes by connecting people with coverage that meets their needs and budgets.

**Role Description**
The Associate Cluster Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Coimbatore. This position is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations across assigned branches or teams, ensuring consistent service quality and adherence to organizational standards. The role includes monitoring performance metrics, coordinating workflows, and supporting staff with guidance and resources to meet customer service and sales targets. The Associate Cluster Manager collaborates with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements, resolve escalated issues, and maintain compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. Regular reporting, team meetings, and field visits are part of the role, along with contributing to training initiatives and developing action plans for operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Strong operational management abilities, including experience overseeing multiple teams or locations and coordinating daily activities.
* Solid customer service and relationship management skills, with the capacity to handle escalations and support diverse client needs.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort with performance metrics, data review, and action planning.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders and guide team members.
* Organizational and time-management skills, including attention to detail and capability to manage competing priorities.
* Basic understanding of health insurance products or willingness to learn quickly; prior experience in financial services or healthcare is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, management, commerce, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Willingness to work on-site in Coimbatore and conduct regular visits to branches or partner locations within the assigned cluster.

title: Regional Account Manager - Emerging
description:
**Job Description**
 Here’s a wonderful opportunity to join the Leading Cybersecurity \& Networking organisation – Fortinet, who truly converge Network \& Security. Fortinet’s Mission \& Vision is “to secure People, Devices and Data everywhere”. Fortinet’s Integrated, AI\-driven Security platform is a Unified, Integrated cybersecurity platform that spans Network, Core, Endpoints, Applications, Cloud, etc.
   

  

 Fortinet portfolio of over 50\+ enterprise\-grade products is the largest integrated offering available, delivering proven cybersecurity everywhere you need it. More than 890,000 customers trust Fortinet solutions, which are among the most deployed, most patented, and most validated in the industry.
   

  

 Fortinet is included in the Fortune 500 list, has made numerous appearances on Fortune Magazine’s listing of 100 Fastest Growing Companies, and has been nominated to Fortune Magazine's Most Admired Companies List.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The “Regional Account Manager (RAM) – Emerging Business” is responsible for driving business thro’ Whitespace customer accounts, driving cybersecurity solution adoption, and working closely with channel partners to grow revenue. The role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity products, partner ecosystems, and enterprise customer needs. The candidate will serve as the primary point of contact for customers and collaborate with channel partners to develop opportunities, close deals, and expand market presence.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Account Management
* Drive business thro’ Whitespace mid\-market Accounts \& ensure high satisfaction and retention.
* Responsible for bringing new logos
* Cross\-sell/ Up\-sell multi\-solution stack, with both existing \& new Accounts
* Leverage Tech\-Days/ Fast track training sessions, to ensure customers have a complete solution understanding of various Fortinet solution to meet their use\-cases
* Leverage partners extensively to cross\-sell to existing Accounts \& penetrate into net new Accounts
* Understand customer security needs, pain points, and ongoing threats; position the right cybersecurity solutions.
* Conduct regular account reviews, QBRs, and roadmap discussions with customers.
* Collaborate with pre\-sales/SE teams to deliver demos, POCs, and solution designs.
* Channel Collaboration
* Work closely with resellers, distributors, MSSPs, and system integrators to drive partner\-led sales.
* Support partners with deal strategy, pricing, proposals, and competitive positioning.
* Ensure channel partners are aligned with the company’s product roadmap, promotions, and incentive programs.
* Resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth deal registration.
* Sales \& Revenue Growth
* Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closure for accounts handled through partners.
* Achieve quarterly and annual sales targets (revenue, pipeline, partner activity).
* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities across the cybersecurity \& Networking portfolio (endpoint, network, cloud, identity, SOC, etc.).
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline using CRM tools.
* Partner \& Customer Enablement
* Conduct product trainings, workshops, and joint account planning with partners.
* Support marketing teams with regional partner events, webinars, and campaigns.
* Ensure customers and partners are aware of threat updates, product enhancements, and new features.
* Market Intelligence \& Reporting
* Track competitor activities, pricing trends, and partner ecosystem performance.
* Provide monthly/quarterly sales forecasts, pipeline reports, and business insights.
* Share customer and partner feedback with product and engineering teams.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field (MBA preferred).
* 10\-12 years of sales/account management experience in Cybersecurity, Networking or IT security.
* Hands\-on experience working with channel partners (distributors, VARs, MSSPs, integrators).
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity domains: Endpoint protection, firewalls, SASE/ ZTNA, SIEM/SOAR, IAM, cloud security, XDR, etc.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building abilities.
* Knowledge of CRM tools (Salesforce/HubSpot) and sales forecasting.


**Preferred Attributes**
* Existing relationships with local cybersecurity partners and distributors.
* Experience selling Enterprise security or Networking solutions
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Strong analytical and presentation skills.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Edelweiss Life Insurance, formerly Edelweiss Tokio Life Insurance, operates nationwide with a strong focus on protecting people’s dreams and aspirations. Since beginning operations in 2011, the company has emphasized innovation, simplicity, and a modern approach to life insurance that matches evolving customer expectations. Edelweiss Life Insurance offers need\-based and innovative solutions designed to help customers live their \#zindagiunlimited. With a customer\-centric mindset, the company uses multiple distribution channels to serve diverse customer segments across the country. Team members join a growing organization committed to long\-term relationships, transparent service, and meaningful financial protection.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in Coimbatore. The Relationship Manager will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective customers, understanding their financial protection needs, and recommending suitable life insurance solutions. Daily activities include meeting clients, explaining product features and benefits in a clear and ethical manner, handling queries, and ensuring a smooth onboarding and policy servicing experience. The role involves coordinating with internal teams to process applications, resolve service issues, and support renewals, as well as maintaining accurate records and customer follow\-ups. The Relationship Manager will also contribute to business growth by identifying new opportunities, participating in local marketing initiatives, and achieving defined sales and service targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Customer relationship and service skills, including the ability to build trust, manage client expectations, and maintain long\-term engagements.
* Sales and business development capabilities, such as prospecting, need\-based selling, and achieving individual and team targets in a structured environment.
* Communication and interpersonal skills, including clear verbal and written communication, active listening, and the ability to explain complex concepts simply.
* Organizational and follow\-up skills, including maintaining accurate records, handling multiple client interactions, and meeting deadlines consistently.
* Basic financial and insurance awareness, with the ability to understand protection and savings products and match them to customer needs.
* Comfort working in an on\-site, customer\-facing role in Coimbatore, with a willingness to travel locally for client meetings as required.
* Proficiency in common office productivity tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or customer management systems).
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in any discipline; prior experience in life insurance, banking, or financial services relationship management is an added advantage.

title: Studio Manager
description:
**Studio Manager** 








* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high\-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross\-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world\-class customer experiences.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer\-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow\-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world\-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long\-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer\-centric, operationally excellent, and high\-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business\- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer\-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations\- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People\-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial \- Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock\-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation\-to\-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow\-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 You will be responsible for leading mid\-size application managed services engagements, managing stakeholders and contractual obligations as the Service Manager.
   

  

 You will be responsible to execute sound Service management and transition plans by engaging with multidisciplinary teams, and by identifying, managing and mitigating risk
   

  

 You will be responsible to develop relationships across the business to understand requirements, applying business and technical acumen to solve business problems, with the vision to Grow, Sustain and Improve the through strong ITSM principles, process, automation, innovation and better ways of working.
   

  

 You will be responsible for Service onboarding, Service Transition, Service operations using ITSM leading practices for products, applications and services delivered at EY.

* Accountable as the point of contact for the service delivery of the Application System
* Enable ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change) end\-to\-end
* Ensure service stability, availability, and reliability
* Drive proactive issue prevention \& risk mitigation
* Establish and maintain operational runbooks \& SOPs
* Manage and communicate with key stakeholders on a weekly and daily basis on the operational support of the Application System

* Coach the team to drive for results applying problem solving skills, architectural thinking, continuous improvements through technology and process and communication efficiency

 As the Service Manager with transition experience

* Confidently articulates Service Management principles and maintains an in\-depth knowledge

description:
**Company Description** 
 Vastu Housing Finance Corporation Ltd., based in Mumbai, is a housing finance company focused on delivering responsible and sustainable credit solutions across India. The organization prioritizes financial inclusion by serving underserved and self\-employed communities in peri\-urban and rural areas, enabling homeownership and long\-term financial stability. Using deep local insights and its proprietary technology platform, Pulse, Vastu provides simple, swift, and customized housing finance solutions that bridge the formal credit gap. As of March 2025, Vastu has supported over 100,000 customers, many with modest monthly incomes and limited documentation, who traditionally struggle to access formal credit. With operations across 15 states and union territories and 340\+ districts, the company offers a decade\-long track record of strong governance, consistent profitability, and robust asset quality.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role is based in Tamil Nadu, India. The Relationship Manager will manage and grow a portfolio of housing finance customers, guiding prospective borrowers through the end\-to\-end loan lifecycle from lead generation and initial inquiry to documentation, credit assessment support, disbursement, and post\-disbursement relationship management. Daily responsibilities include sourcing new business in designated markets, conducting customer visits, understanding customer income profiles and housing needs, and explaining loan products, terms, and processes in a clear and ethical manner. The role involves coordinating with credit, operations, and collections teams to ensure timely processing, compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements, and maintaining strong asset quality. The Relationship Manager will also monitor customer accounts, address service issues, encourage timely repayments, and represent Vastu as a trusted partner in local communities.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship management skills with the ability to build trust, understand needs, and maintain long\-term borrower relationships.
* Business development and sales skills, including lead generation, field sourcing, and closing housing finance opportunities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in English and local languages, with the ability to explain financial products clearly and respectfully.
* Basic financial analysis and credit understanding, including assessment of income profiles, documentation, and repayment capacity.
* Familiarity with housing finance, retail lending, or broader financial services, especially in peri\-urban and rural markets.
* Comfort with using digital tools and platforms (mobile apps, CRM systems, and loan management systems) to manage customer data and workflows.
* Ability to work on\-site in the field, travel within assigned territory, and operate independently while adhering to company policies and compliance standards.
* Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in housing finance or NBFCs is an advantage.
